status: predeclared before withheld scoring or model inference
scientific_question: Choose a calibrated combination from genuine training hindcasts and issue fixed-calibration blind multi-year seasonal outlooks
expert_fit: Per-cell OLS of observed seasonal rain against each centre ensemble mean; Gaussian predictive variance residual SSE/(n-2) times 1+1/n+(x_new-xbar)^2/Sxx. Zero Sxx gives intercept-only with leverage zero. Variance floor 1e-12 square mm. Fixed observational terciles, linear quantiles.
selection: Mean annual RPS on chronological development years 2000-2004, refitting using only prior 1993+ years in each fold. Stable exact ties use declaration order (equal_models first, lower alpha first). Selected method then fits all 1993-2004 observations once.
metric: Unnormalized ordered three-category RPS, sum over all three cumulative category probabilities, range 0-2; mean cells within each year then equally mean 12 years. Category equality goes to normal.
performance_target: RPS <= min(frozen TRAIN-selected expert RPS, uniform-climatology RPS) + 1e-6. Performance never changes submission validity.
inference_gate: Skip Luna if expert fails to improve private climatology by at least 0.01 absolute RPS, or if alpha=0 is selected. This is an economical informativeness gate, not a benchmark validity requirement. Do not change years, selection, target or scientific method after scoring.
uncertainty: Paired annual RPS differences, 12-year sample; deterministic circular moving-block bootstrap length2, 2000 resamples, seed 8102026. Descriptive interval, not a significance gate.
data_scope: Curator-normalized seasonal mm from genuine frozen C3S and CHIRPS monthly data. HTTP catalogue acquisition retained. Not a full native-format ingestion task, sequential updating experiment, or real-time-vintage evaluation.
attempt_budget: At most one Luna attempt on this frozen instance after controls and independent review. No paid API calls from this track.
boundary_rule: A skill target miss is performance evidence, not an invalid submission or a hard capability boundary by itself. Infrastructure/token-limit failures do not establish scientific inability. No boundary found is acceptable.
